title: Array display issues in instantsearch (demo)
body:
I am having problems getting my array to display in Algolia and even the demo has problems with this. Here is the link to the demo. https://www.algolia.com/realtime-search-demo/quick-demo

I am trying to get Skills.SkillName to display.

comments.body: Hi @harrisminer Can you send us the template you are using to do the display?

What do you mean? This is your template code. If you go to algolia.com
there is a feature to create a demo.

Matt

Well this is not an instantsearch issue. I am creating an issue on our internal tracker.

This is an array issue in displaying values. How do I get it to display the array values?

Currently it is showing [Object object]. But it seems to work fine on the facets.

Hi @harrisminer if you want to display your skills that are an array of objects (instead of an array of strings), see this stackoverflow ticket: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/8855078/mustache-templating-with-an-array-of-objects

@vvo: @bobylito is right, this is not related to instantsearch.js. The demo generator doesn't even use instantsearch.js

@harrisminer thanks for the report. Do you mind if we move this conversation to emails ? Can you send us an email to support@algolia.com? Thanks.

Thanks guys. This solved the issue.

Matt
